mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a -5% YoY drop in INDPRO, indicating the market is discounting a quick recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, as measured by the month-over-month change in the civilian unemployment rate, signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Retail sales (RSAFS) continue to grow at a 3%+ YoY clip despite rising unemployment, indicating consumer resilience that will support equity prices.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve, as measured by the spread between the 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals a tightening of financial conditions that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Equity market volatility (VIX) fails to rise above 20 during yield curve flattening episodes, indicating investor complacency that negates the bearish signal.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts, as measured by the month-over-month change in the number of housing units started, signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Housing starts growth fails to translate into rising home prices (CSUSHPINSA) over the subsequent 6 months, indicating a lack of sustainable demand that will limit the positive equity market impact.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating pace of job growth, as measured by the 3-month moving average of the month-over-month change in nonfarm payrolls, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Real wage growth (CPIAUCSL adjusted PAYEMS) fails to keep pace with inflation over the subsequent 6 months, indicating a weakening consumer that will limit the positive equity market impact.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the ISM manufacturing PMI, as measured by the month-over-month change in the index, signals a weakening manufacturing sector that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: ISM PMI drops > 5 points in 1 month
failure_condition: Equity market breadth, as measured by the percentage of S&P 500 stocks trading above their 200-day moving average, remains above 80% during PMI drop episodes, indicating a resilient market that is likely to recover quickly.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate, as measured by the month-over-month change in the effective federal funds rate, signals a tightening of monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 2-year Treasury yield fails to rise in response to the Fed funds rate hike, indicating a market that is skeptical of the tightening cycle and likely to continue rallying.
